text: 经查，财通证券股份有限公司存在经纪业务在内部制度建设、账户监测预警处理、权限管理等方面存在不足。自营业务在部门及岗位职能独立、交易指令审核、询价活动监测、合规人员派驻、稽核工作等方面存在不足。证监会浙江监管局决定对财通证券股份有限公司采取出具警示函的行政监督管理措施，并记入证券期货市场诚信档案。
text_en: Upon investigation, Caitong Securities Co., Ltd. was found to have deficiencies in its brokerage business regarding internal system construction, account monitoring and early warning handling, and permission management. Its proprietary business also showed shortcomings in department and position functional independence, trade instruction review, inquiry activity monitoring, compliance personnel placement, and audit work. The CSRC Zhejiang Regulatory Bureau has decided to impose administrative supervisory measures in the form of a warning letter on Caitong Securities Co., Ltd., and record it in the securities and futures market integrity archive.
